routines.name: apply_late_fees
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bench.apply_late_fees(p_fee numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.payment p
  SET amount = p.amount + p_fee
  FROM public.rental r
  WHERE r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    AND r.return_date IS NULL;
END;
$function$

category_depth
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bench.category_depth()
 RETURNS TABLE(category_id integer, depth integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT c.category_id, 1 AS depth FROM public.category c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.category_id, t.depth + 1
    FROM public.category c JOIN tree t ON c.category_id = t.category_id
  )
  SELECT category_id, max(depth) FROM tree GROUP BY category_id;
$function$

routines.name: cte_top_films
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bench.cte_top_films(p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(title text, rentals bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH counts AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, count(*) AS n
    FROM public.rental r
    JOIN public.inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
  )
  SELECT f.title::text, c.n
  FROM counts c
  JOIN public.film f ON f.film_id = c.film_id
  ORDER BY c.n DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

purge_orphan_payments
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bench.purge_orphan_payments()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  WITH orphans AS (
    SELECT p.payment_id FROM public.payment p
    LEFT JOIN public.rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    WHERE r.rental_id IS NULL
  )
  DELETE FROM public.payment WHERE payment_id IN (SELECT payment_id FROM orphans);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bench.refresh_store_stats()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  EXECUTE format('TRUNCATE %I.%I', 'bench', 'store_stats');
  INSERT INTO bench.store_stats (store_id, customers)

  FROM public.customer
  GROUP BY store_id;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bench.upsert_store_stat(p_store integer, p_customers bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO bench.store_stats (store_id, customers)
  VALUES (p_store, p_customers)
  ON CONFLICT (store_id) DO UPDATE SET customers = excluded.customers;
END;
$function$

routines.name: _group_concat
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._group_concat(text, text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
SELECT CASE
  WHEN $2 IS NULL THEN $1
  WHEN $1 IS NULL THEN $2
  ELSE $1 || ', ' || $2
END
$function$

routines.name: get_customer_balance
routines.args: p_customer_id integer, p_effective_date timestamp with time zone
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_balance(p_customer_id integer, p_effective_date timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
       --#OK, WE NEED TO CALCULATE THE CURRENT BALANCE GIVEN A CUSTOMER_ID AND A DATE
       --#THAT WE WANT THE BALANCE TO BE EFFECTIVE FOR. THE BALANCE IS:
       --#   1) RENTAL FEES FOR ALL PREVIOUS RENTALS
       --#   2) ONE DOLLAR FOR EVERY DAY THE PREVIOUS RENTALS ARE OVERDUE
       --#   3) IF A FILM IS MORE THAN RENTAL_DURATION * 2 OVERDUE, CHARGE THE REPLACEMENT_COST
       --#   4) SUBTRACT ALL PAYMENTS MADE BEFORE THE DATE SPECIFIED
DECLARE
    v_rentfees DECIMAL(5,2); --#FEES PAID TO RENT THE VIDEOS INITIALLY
    v_overfees INTEGER;      --#LATE FEES FOR PRIOR RENTALS
    v_payments DECIMAL(5,2); --#SUM OF PAYMENTS MADE PREVIOUSLY
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(film.rental_rate),0) INTO v_rentfees
    FROM film, inventory, rental
    WHERE film.film_id = inventory.film_id
      AND inventory.inventory_id = rental.inventory_id
      AND rental.rental_date <= p_effective_date
      AND rental.customer_id = p_customer_id;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(IF((rental.return_date - rental.rental_date) > (film.rental_duration * '1 day'::interval),
        ((rental.return_date - rental.rental_date) - (film.rental_duration * '1 day'::interval)),0)),0) INTO v_overfees
    FROM rental, inventory, film
    WHERE film.film_id = inventory.film_id
      AND inventory.inventory_id = rental.inventory_id
      AND rental.rental_date <= p_effective_date
      AND rental.customer_id = p_customer_id;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(payment.amount),0) INTO v_payments
    FROM payment
    WHERE payment.payment_date <= p_effective_date
    AND payment.customer_id = p_customer_id;

    RETURN v_rentfees + v_overfees - v_payments;
END
$function$

routines.name: inventory_held_by_customer
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventory_held_by_customer(p_inventory_id integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_customer_id INTEGER;
BEGIN

  SELECT customer_id INTO v_customer_id
  FROM rental
  WHERE return_date IS NULL
  AND inventory_id = p_inventory_id;

  RETURN v_customer_id;
END $function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.last_day(timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS date
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM $1) = 12 THEN
      (((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM $1) + 1) operator(pg_catalog.||) '-01-01')::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date
    ELSE
      ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM $1) operator(pg_catalog.||) '-' operator(pg_catalog.||) (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM $1) + 1) operator(pg_catalog.||) '-01')::date - INTERVAL '1 day')::date
    END
$function$
